description: An authentic life looks like not fearing isolation #selflove #isolation #growthmindset
transcript: I learned very, very early that being authentic meant being comfortable with being alone. I have always lived my life as myself and learned that the world doesn't always like that. The world is judgmental. The world likes to put you in a box. And the more that I had the confidence to explore my life better and the stronger that the relationship I had with myself became, are comfortable I got with isolation. I am comfortable being me, even if that means being me alone in my own world.
